items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: Me and I, you know, Tom played down here. Played by Preservation Hall.

ctx.x: What made you decide to come here? Well, I played.
Me and I, you know, Tom played down here. Played by Preservation Hall. St. Houston.
Was it, it was called Preservation Hall back then? Right. Uh-huh. And me and my brother there played that.
